heading: Retaining wall forming part of a building
content:
48.
Retaining wall forming part of a building
Any retaining wall, which forms part of any domestic building shall, subject to the provisions of regulation 27—
(a)
be properly waterproofed to prevent dampness in the building;
(b)
be properly insulated to prevent condensation on the internal face of any room intended for habitation within the building.
